messages:
CI-Bench-Bot: :rotating_light: nightly-perf-alert: job=small-batch-latency, env=nightly, p50=22ms p95=58ms p99=120ms (baseline p99=45ms) -- suspect change around commit 2001a3f
Ava: saw this when I checked the dashboard at 05:12. p99 jump looks consistent across regions.
Chris: thanks for the ping. I'm triggering a bisect run now against the last 10 commits. will post the job link.
Chris: bisect job: https://ci.redwood/inference/bisect/2001009999 (queued)
Mika: can someone drop the failing CI job logs or a snapshot name? I want to try repro locally with the same inputs.
Chris: snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-nightly/2001009900/bench-snap.tar.gz -- contains kv-cache warmup traces + small-batch workload.
Ava: copy that. I'm also seeing memory climb from ~1.8GB -> 3.6GB during the 2nd stage of the run, which might be related. quick grep from the runner logs:
```
[00:06:12] cache:init size=0
[00:06:18] cache:prefill keys=1024 time_ms=312
[00:06:22] runtime:alloc 1.8GB
[00:07:01] runtime:alloc 3.6GB
[00:07:03] small-batch:latency p99=120.4ms
```
Chris: hmm, cache prefill doubled memory, could be an accidental shader/buffer retention after recent allocator change in 2001a3f.
Sam: assigning myself to the bisect and local repro. I'll run the s3 snapshot and compare memory profiles between good vs bad commit.
Mika: if you need a local cluster, I can spin up a smallinfra dev pod (g4dn) and attach a perf container. ping me when bisect picks a commit.
Chris: bisect started, current candidate build=2001a3f (bad) vs 1f9b8e2 (good). ETA ~12min per run.
CI-Bench-Bot: bisect update: tested 2001a3f -> failed; tested 1f9b8e2 -> passed; narrowing range. next pair queued.
Ava: if the allocator is the culprit we should revert the micro-opt in allocator::reuse_pool (PR #1422) on a canary to confirm. low-effort rollback.
Sam: running local compare now. grabbing snapshot and building both hashes. will report memory graphs here.
Mika: tagging @infra-oncall in case we need extra GPU quota for parallel bisect runs.
Chris: noted. infra-oncall pinged. also, adding a temporary dashboard alert rule to increase sampling during the bisect so we get hotter traces.
Sam: quick status: built good and bad. reproducing... bad commit shows GC spikes aligned with cache:prefill. attaching small flame snippet (truncated):
```
CPU: runtime::gc -> 38%
CPU: allocator::retain_buffers -> 24%
CPU: kv_cache::insert -> 18%
```
Ava: :eyes: that looks like buffers aren't being freed between prefill cycles. Could be an ownership change in allocator.
Chris: good signal. Sam, if you can capture a heap diff (good vs bad) that would be ideal.
Sam: will run heap diff next. if confirmed, I'll open a revert PR and link to this thread.
Mika: FYI I ran a quick experiment locally with the allocator flag turned off (--allocator-reuse=false) and p99 dropped to ~48ms, memory steady at ~1.9GB.
Ava: great repro, that strongly implicates the reuse path.
Chris: plan: Sam to run final verification and open revert PR if heap diffs show retained buffers. I'll prepare a canary rollout with revert if Sam's quick verification fails to regress.
Sam: on it. ETA 30m. will post diffs and PR link.
Ava: thanks all. please add any follow-ups to the bisect job and tag me if you need escalation. :thumbsup:
CI-Bench-Bot: closing note: nightly alert annotated with bisect job id and current assignee Sam.
